## RECON REPORT: How-It-Works Page Shared Infrastructure

### 1. Reusable Shared Components

All these exist and are **ready to use** in `/src/components/shared/`:

| Component | Props | Usage |

| **[Footer](file:///Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq%20App/Marketing%20Site/Boldteq/src/components/layout/footer.tsx)** | None (self-contained) — uses `SITE_CONFIG.social`, `footerLinks` object | Newsletter form, social links, 4-column link grid, copyright |

| **[NewsletterSignup](file:///Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq%20App/Marketing%20Site/Boldteq/src/components/shared/newsletter-signup.tsx)** | None (self-contained) | Email form with submit state management (`/api/newsletter` endpoint) |
| **[CtaBanner](file:///Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq%20App/Marketing%20Site/Boldteq/src/components/shared/cta-banner.tsx)** | `title`, `subtitle`, `primaryCta`, `secondaryCta`, `bullets`, `align` ("center" or "left") | Flexible blue CTA section — used at page bottom for demo booking |
| **[PageHero](file:///Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq%20App/Marketing%20Site/Boldteq/src/components/shared/page-hero.tsx)** | `title`, `subtitle`, `badge`, `className`, `children` | Navy hero section with optional badge + heading + subtitle + slots |
| **[SectionWrapper](file:///Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq%20App/Marketing%20Site/Boldteq/src/components/shared/section-wrapper.tsx)** | `variant` ("light" \| "dark" \| "navy" \| "gradient" \| "muted"), `id`, `className` | Container section with bg color + max-width + padding — use for consistency |

### 2. Image Assets in `/public/images/webflow/`

**Already used in how-it-works components:**
- `Rectangle-243.png`, `Rectangle-244.png`, `Rectangle-186.png` — process screenshot embeds
- `Layer_1-3.svg`, `Layer_1-10.svg`, `Layer_1-20.svg`, `Layer_1-21.svg`, `Layer_1-22.svg`, `Layer_1-25.svg`, `Layer_1-26.svg`, `Layer_1-30.svg`, `Layer_1-32.svg`, `Layer_1-37.svg`, `Layer_1-38.svg` — stat badges, icon system

**Note:** `/public/images/webflow/` contains ~485 total files (hashed + variants). Search for content-specific images via Webflow export logs if the numbered files don't match your needs.

### 3. Existing Constants (How-It-Works Relevant)

**Navigation** [`/src/lib/constants/navigation.ts`](file:///Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq%20App/Marketing%20Site/Boldteq/src/lib/constants/navigation.ts):
- `NAV_ITEMS` includes `{ label: "How It Works", href: "/how-it-works" }`

- Footer also links to `/how-it-works` in the "About" column

**Note:** No dedicated `/src/lib/constants/how-it-works.ts` exists. All step content is hardcoded in component files (see section 4).

### 4. Existing Patterns in Built Pages

**Home page** ([`hero.tsx`](file:///Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq%20App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/src/components/home/hero.tsx)) uses:
- Badge + h2 + h1 + paragraph intro layout
- Trust badge grid (3-column, icon + text)
- GuideJar iframe embed (exact same approach as how-it-works hero)
- CTA button pair (primary + outline)
- Gradient background section

**Pricing page** ([`custom-plan-cta.tsx`](file:///Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq%20App/Marketing Site/Boldteq/src/components/pricing/custom-plan-cta.tsx)) uses:
- Card container with heading + subtitle
- Bullet list with checkmark icon + text

**Copy-Pattern Blueprint:** Use [ProcessSteps](file:///Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq%20App/Marketing%20Site/Boldteq/src/components/how-it-works/process-steps.tsx) (2-column header grid + 4-step grid) and [HowWorksSteps](file:///Users/yashbaldha/Desktop/Boldteq%20App/Marketing%20Site/Boldteq/src/components/how-it-works/how-works-steps.tsx) (3-step feature cards with screenshot embeds) as reference.

**Immediately reusable:** Navbar, Footer, BetaCta, CtaBanner, Button primitive, animations (FadeIn, ScrollReveal). **Page structure:** Existing how-it-works page is partially built with 5 sections (hero, agency-fit, 2x process, risk-removal, beta-cta). **CSS:** Tailwind + Roobert font + brand color/gradient tokens are defined globally. **Pattern:** Stat badge grids, card layouts, screenshot embeds, and GuideJar iframes already proven in codebase.
